// Gruvbox Material Dark Soft, the retired shell line's ANSI-256 values as hex.
export const PALETTE = {
  peach: '#d7875f',
  green: '#a9b665',
  teal: '#87afaf',
  mauve: '#d787af',
  yellow: '#d8a657',
  red: '#d75f5f',
  orange: '#e78a4e',
  muted: '#878787',
} as const

export type Tone = keyof typeof PALETTE

// Context warns early: red is the 70% line where the threshold guard asks for a save and clear.
export const ctxTone = (pct: number): Tone =>
  pct >= 70 ? 'red' : pct >= 40 ? 'orange' : 'green'

export const limitTone = (pct: number): Tone =>
  pct >= 90 ? 'red' : pct >= 70 ? 'yellow' : 'green'

export const DENY_AGENT = `CONTEXT THRESHOLD (70%+): Agent spawns are blocked at this context level.
Save session state (save-session skill) and clear context first, then retry.`

export const stillOver = (taskId?: string): string =>
  taskId
    ? `CONTEXT SOFT STOP (still 70%+, agent task: ${taskId}): Save your current state and return early.
Invoke the save-session skill to write progress to .agents/claimed/${taskId}.state.md,
then stop and return a status summary to the orchestrator.`
    : 'CONTEXT SOFT STOP (still 70%+): Save session state, then ask the user to clear context before continuing.'

export const firstCrossing = (taskId?: string): string =>
  taskId
    ? `CONTEXT SOFT STOP (70%+, agent task: ${taskId}): Last tool completed. Context at threshold.

This is an autonomous agent context — do not wait for user input. Instead:
1. Invoke the save-session skill to write current progress to:
     .agents/claimed/${taskId}.state.md
2. Return early to the orchestrator with a status summary:
     "Context threshold reached at 70%+. State saved. Completed: [X]. Remaining: [Y]."
3. Do not start new tool calls other than save-session writes and git reads.`
    : `CONTEXT SOFT STOP (70%+): Last tool completed. Context is at threshold.

1. Invoke the save-session skill now to persist progress.
2. Then ask the user to clear or compact context before further work.

Do not execute further tool calls unless they are part of saving session state
(save-session writes, git reads, memory writes).`
files.types/index.d.ts:
export type PueueState = 'Queued' | 'Running' | 'Paused' | 'Done' | 'Failed' | 'Killed' | 'Other'

export type PueueTask = {
  id: number
  label?: string
  cwd: string
  state: PueueState
  exit?: number
  createdMs?: number
  enqueuedMs?: number
  startMs?: number
  endMs?: number
  command: string
}

export type TranscriptEntry = { kind: 'text' | 'tool' | 'error'; text: string }

export type PiProgress = {
  offset: number
  partial: string
  tokens: number
  cost: number
  model?: string
  effort?: string
  lastActivity?: string
  lastEventMs?: number
  lastEventAssistant?: boolean
  files: string[]
  entries: TranscriptEntry[]
  error?: string
  models: Record<string, number>
}

export type TrackedTask = {
  id: number
  sessionId?: string
  runId?: string
  label?: string
  cwd: string
  addedMs: number
  task?: PueueTask
  finishedMs?: number
  dismissed?: boolean
}

export type HandoffState = { tasks: TrackedTask[]; available: boolean; selectedId?: number; confirm?: { action: 'kill' | 'hold'; ids: number[]; atMs: number } }

export type HistoryCache = {
  path?: string
  size?: number
  mtimeMs?: number
  tokens?: number
  cost?: number
  tail?: string
  loading?: boolean
  available?: boolean
}

// One worktree of the repo the session is in, with the facts the pane shows. `live` counts fresh sessions inside it.
export type WorktreeRow = { path: string; head: string; branch?: string; detached: boolean; prunable: boolean; changes: number; ahead: number; behind: number; live: number }
export type WorktreeBranch = { name: string; upstream?: string; worktree?: string; ahead?: number; behind?: number }
export type WorktreeState = { open: boolean; legend: boolean; selected?: string; data?: { rows: WorktreeRow[]; branches: WorktreeBranch[]; at: number } }

export type HistoryState = {
  tasks: PueueTask[]
  reviews: Record<number, 'pending' | 'decided, waiting for the next Pi run in this repo' | 'approved' | 'changes requested' | undefined>
  usage: Record<string, HistoryCache | undefined>
  /** Keyed `<id>:<endMs>` (pueue reuses ids): whether that finished Failed(1) run's log shows it left a review. */
  leftReviews: Record<string, boolean>
  filter: 'all' | 'done' | 'failed' | 'killed'
  limit: number
  selectedId?: number
  open: boolean
  available: boolean
}

export type GitSnapshot = {
  branch: string
  isDirty: boolean
  ahead: number
  behind: number
  hasUpstream: boolean
  stash: number
  worktree?: string
}

// Whole percentages as the status line showed them; absent off a subscription.
export type Usage = { ctx?: number; five?: number; seven?: number }

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'session-band': {
      usage: Usage
      git: GitSnapshot | null
      outputStyle: string | null
      isNotified: boolean
      edits: number
      prompts: number
      handoff: HandoffState
      progress: Record<number, PiProgress>
      history: HistoryState
      worktrees: WorktreeState
      sendIt: boolean
    }
  }
}
